text:
jamie: Quick sync — we need to pick a canonical place to attach tenant affiliation used for billing/chargeback. Options: edge SDK/proxy header, obs-gateway enrichment, or late-enrich during ingest. Pros/cons below.

maria: I lean edge header. It's closest to the request so attribution is most accurate for short-lived flows. Main worry is spoofing if we trust an unverified header. We could sign the tenant_id with HMAC using a per-customer key.

ken: Signing + verification is the right primitive. Suggested flow: edge adds `X-RW-Tenant: org_12345` and `X-RW-Tenant-Sig: base64(hmac)`. Gateway verifies signature and promotes the value into the envelope as the canonical `tenant_id`. If verification fails, mark `tenant_id=unverified`.

jamie: Example header shape:```http
X-RW-Tenant: org_12345
X-RW-Ts: 1680000000
X-RW-Tenant-Sig: mFv8y...base64
```Include timestamp in sig to prevent replay.

tasha: A couple of operational caveats: (1) sampling — if we sample at edge, some requests with the header won't reach the gateway and we'll lose chargeback signal; (2) storage/cost — persisting full tenant on every span/metric balloons index sizes. We should consider a short, stable `billing_key` (hashed) to store on high-volume signals and only keep full `tenant_id` on lower-volume commit events.

jamie: Good call. Proposal: edge writes `X-RW-Billing-Key: sha256(org_12345 + salt)` (small, stable, non-reversible). Gateway verifies any signature and writes `billing_key` into the envelope (required). `tenant_id` promotion is optional and only applied for billing-critical events. For traces that arrive without a valid sig, we run a late-lookup against auth to try to resolve tenant (with a `late_lookup:true` tag) and otherwise mark `tenant_id=unknown`.

ken: Also need replay protection and idempotency. Include `X-RW-Ts` and include it in the HMAC input. Gateway should accept sigs in a ±60s window and drop stale ones. Also, add a small per-tenant rate limit on late lookups to avoid auth service overload during bursts.

op-bot: ingest-gateway: schema v2 accepted for `billing_key` field. :white_check_mark:

maria: Sounds reasonable. I'll pick up a 2d spike to implement the edge header + gateway verification + a fallback late-lookup path. Will add integration tests for signature verification and sampling scenarios.

jamie: Great — action items: (1) maria spike + PR, (2) eng-platform RFC update documenting `billing_key` semantics and sampling implications, (3) ops playbook for `tenant_id=unverified` and late-lookup failures. Ping here when PR lands. :thumbsup:
